description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten digit "7" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive style with a slightly slanted and flowing appearance. The top of the "7" features a short horizontal line that curves slightly downward, while the vertical stroke extends downward from the right end of the horizontal line. The bottom of the vertical stroke tapers off gently. The overall shape is smooth and continuous, suggesting it was drawn quickly with a single motion
